root.name: シンクロニー・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: 最大級のプログラム提携先のひとつで、取引関係は46年に及ぶ
relations.text_en: Lowe's is one of the five largest programs, with a relationship of 46 years

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The length of our relationship with each of our five largest partners is over 14 years, and in the case of Lowe's, 46 years.

relations.text: 上位5プログラムのひとつで、デジタル提携先として挙げられている
relations.text_en: Amazon is one of the five largest programs by interest and fees on loans

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our five largest programs based upon interest and fees on loans for the year ended December 31, 2025, were Amazon, Lowe’s, PayPal, Sam’s Club and TJX Companies, Inc.

relations.text: 提携は21年に及び、Venmoプログラムも含む
relations.text_en: The partnership spans 21 years and includes the Venmo program

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: At December 31, 2025, the length of our relationship with each of our three largest partners was over 10 years, and in the case of PayPal, 21 years.

relations.text: 大手小売提携先6社のひとつで、上位5プログラムにも入る
relations.text_en: TJX is one of six large retail partners in the Diversified & Value platform

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our Diversified & Value sales platform is comprised of six large retail partners: Belk, Fleet Farm, JCPenney, OnePay, Sam's Club and TJX Companies, Inc.

relations.text: 2025年9月、ウォルマート向けのクレジットカードプログラムで新たに提携した
relations.text_en: In September 2025 Synchrony launched a partnership with OnePay for credit card programs at Walmart

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In September 2025, we launched our new partnership with OnePay to become the exclusive issuer of a general purpose and private label credit card program at Walmart.

relations.text: 自動車関連のホーム＆オート提携先として挙げられている
relations.text_en: Chevron is named among the automotive Home & Auto partners

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: as well as automotive merchandise and services, such as Chevron and Discount Tire.

relations.text: デジタル販売プラットフォームの提携先として挙げられている
relations.text_en: Verizon is named among the digital-first merchant partners

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: and digital-first brands and merchants, such as the QVC Group, Inc., Verizon and Virgin Red.

relations.text: 主要契約は2030年12月まで続く、取引処理や預金基盤の委託先
relations.text_en: Fiserv provides processing and deposit platform services under an agreement expiring in December 2030

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our principal agreement with Fiserv for technology, production, and online retail deposits services expires in December 2030, unless it is terminated earlier or is extended pursuant to the terms thereof.

companies.name: ブレッド・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: 提携先の獲得をめぐる主な競合として挙げられている
relations.text_en: Bread Financial is named a primary competitor for partners

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our primary competitors for partners include major financial institutions such as American Express, Bread Financial, Capital One/Discover, JPMorgan Chase, Citibank, TD Bank and Wells Fargo, as well as, financial technology companies, point-of-sale lending focused companies and potential partners’ own in-house financing capabilities.

companies.name: アメリカン・エキスプレス

relations.text: 提携先の獲得をめぐる主な競合として挙げられている
relations.text_en: American Express is named a primary competitor for partners

source.label: Synchrony 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Our primary competitors for partners include major financial institutions such as American Express, Bread Financial, Capital One/Discover, JPMorgan Chase, Citibank, TD Bank and Wells Fargo, as well as, financial technology companies, point-of-sale lending focused companies and potential partners’ own in-house financing capabilities.
